doc.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Closing thanks and a third pick, Hank Jones
summary: Woods thanks Simmons; he adds Hank Jones as his third piano favorite.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Let me tell you we’ve had a marvelous time here discussing the history of jazz and piano technique with Norman Simmons, and we’ve been filming here for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. And thank you very much.
Oh my third piano player before we go.
Hank Jones. Hank Jones. Don’t forget it.
